1. The filter that watched one of two doors

Super confines each Carrier with a seccomp filter that denies 28 syscalls by number. On x86-64 a process can issue the same numbers in a second numbering space: x32 sets bit 30, and the kernel reports those calls as x86-64. The filter checked the architecture and let them through, so
23 of the 28 denied calls reached their handlers
among them. The fix refuses every number with the x32 bit set. It closes the whole space, where extending the list would have closed one number at a time.
(measured against the frozen filter on this kernel).
